summary: Reviewed the consolidated plan for refactor-rigor-gradient-pipeline. One P2 finding at Phase 4a: the atomic-write contract is stated but not verified by any test. Otherwise sound.

findings.title: Phase 4a atomic-write contract lacks verification task
findings.what_wrong: BC-PIPE-015 (atomic writes) has a fulfills claim in Phase 4a but no test scenario exercises a crash mid-write. Implementer may ship without proving atomicity.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test scenario under the Phase 4a task claiming BC-PIPE-015 that kills the process between tmp-write and rename, then asserts state.json parses.
